unit: Geometry · Chapter XI. Areas and volumes
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 9 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: The volume of a pyramid is one third of the base area times the height: V = ⅓ S · h.
stages.headlineEnglish: The volume of a pyramid is one third of the base area times the height: V = ⅓ S · h.

stages.headline: A prism with the same base and height has three times the pyramid's volume.
stages.headlineEnglish: A prism with the same base and height has three times the pyramid's volume.

stages.headline: Example: a square base with side 6 and h = 5 ⇒ V = ⅓ · 36 · 5 = 60.
stages.headlineEnglish: Example: a square base with side 6 and h = 5 ⇒ V = ⅓ · 36 · 5 = 60.
